summary: Up 0.1 from w14 (8.4), with no high-severity issues. The w14 medium issue is fixed. The trim-A ear chips are no longer polka dots: they are pointed and mixed in size, with bright flecks between them. Blob stats on the p4 ear now match py_37305 almost exactly: n 104 against 110, median area 1.09e-3 against 1.25e-3 W^2, elongation 1.63 against 1.65, cover 0.141 against 0.156, and ground #4b4e5c against #4e505e (montage w15b/fab_montage.png, top row). The trim-B Y / asterisk clusters are gone, and the q13 backs now read as random directional slivers like py_37302 (w15b/q13_cmp.png). The back weave contrast came down only part of the way: p8 measures p90/p50 1.34 and hpSD 0.202, against a target of 1.25-1.30 and 0.17-0.19. The longer dashes (N(25, 3) px, about 16 mm) now make the blocks about 1.5-2x as long as py_37301's 11 mm dashes, so the backs read as coarse bricks rather than fine dashes. That one is mine from w14, and it overshot. Three issues hold the score below 8.7. (1) Low-medium: the trim-B ears (pyWingB) are too dark, darker than their back, where the photo ears are as light as the back or lighter. (2) Low-medium: the trim-A dashes are too long and coarse. (3) Low: the pocket recess and holder plate are still darker than the shell (unchanged). Geometry is unchanged from w14 and still good: back and cushion shape, ears, flap, console, shell, pocket and gooseneck.
lighting_note: Not scored. The sun diamond is still on the 26B back in q14 (x 490-550, y 310-400; w15b/q14_sun.png). The new exposure pass darkens the studio p8 back to #667085 (py_37301 #94a2ba), while the p8 cushion stays near the photo (#9ba3b3 against #939eb3), so back and cushion now differ more than in the photo. In q14 the backs read pale blue-white against py_37303's mid grey (q14 near back #778197 S 0.22 against #929daf S 0.18; the brightness is fine, but the weave sparkle makes it read lighter). In q13 the trim-B back fg is #646f88 S 0.27 against py_37302's #687ba2 S 0.36: still cooler and less saturated than the photo light. Outside PY, also in q13: the carpet is saturated royal blue (py_37302 has a dark navy-charcoal carpet), and the divider curtains read violet-blue (py_37302 charcoal). These are for the monuments, shell and lighting raters.

calibration.issue: w14b medium / w14a medium: trim-A ear chips are uniform round or hexagonal polka dots, with no pointed tips, notches or small flecks
calibration.status: Fixed. p4 ear blobs: n 104, median area 1.09e-3 W^2, elongation 1.63 and cover 0.141 (w14: 54 / 2.34e-3 / 1.38 / 0.174; py_37305: 110 / 1.25e-3 / 1.65 / 0.156). The ground is #4b4e5c against #4e505e. Mixed sizes, pointed chips and the fleck field are visible in p4, q14 and q13 (w15b/fab_montage.png, top row). Residual (low): the larger chips are angular shards or ovals rather than the five-lobed sakura blossom outlines of py_37305, which have a rounded petal with a V notch.

The fill is better and the bright cover halved. The longer dashes (ln N(25, 3)) made the blocks coarser, though. The horizontal correlation length on p8 is 0.054 of the back width, against 0.028 on py_37301 (see issue 2).

issues.issue: The trim-A back dashes are now about 1.5-2x too long. The backs and cushions read as coarse soft bricks, where py_37301 / 37303 show fine short dashes, and contrast is still about 5 % high. My w14 fix (ln N(21, 4) -> N(25, 3)) traded fill for length, and it should have kept the length and shortened the gaps.

The synth_py_back docstring measures p50 dash about 11 mm (18 px at 1570 px/m), while the current ln is 25 px (16 mm). p8 back: p90/p50 1.34, hpSD 0.202 (py_37301 1.26 / 0.178). q14: 1.31 / 0.193 (py_37303 1.23 / 0.143).
